active_simple_capacity_rule: Primary frozen selection budget is one semantic atom removed per recipient, with exact union count reported. The relationship atom has six encoded columns and no other atom has width six; different one-atom common deletions cannot match C-SIMPLE-REL0 expanded-column capacity. Report encoded local/union counts, actual selected-value dtype, and feature payload bits = dtype itemsize times 8 times encoded columns. Different-width arms are frontier context only. A Team C internal competitive comparator must be a different eligible nonalias C-SIMPLE arm at identical semantic and encoded local/union capacities; if none exists, the C internal competitive method clause is INCOMPLETE, while simple utility/privacy findings remain reportable. S1 may additionally admit another compatible feature-track control under the campaign rule.
